caption:
Same company, same quarter: roles being cut on one floor, roles being posted on another. LatestLY's reporting on the 2026 corporate India restructuring wave — including the Times Group OMS restructure, where around 40 employees were asked to leave — shows both happening at once.

Understand what that means. Cuts are not a verdict on competence. They are a verdict on clarity. Leadership retains the people it can picture in the future org chart. If they cannot picture you, your output does not save you.

This is why presence stops being a soft skill in a restructuring year. Bearing in the room. Tone that does not ask permission. Calculated silence instead of filling air. These are the things that make a name land when the chart is being redrawn behind a closed door.

Be the person they can see there. Not the person they have to be reminded about.
